slides.title: Review
items: On Tuesday we made our first oscilloscope measurements with the AD2, and we wired a pushbutton to a pin of the STM32C031C6.
Today we'll put the scope on the button itself and see what actually happens on the pin when it is pushed.
We'll then fix the switch bounce in hardware, by putting a capacitor across the switch, and we'll discuss ways to write the toggleLED program.
